text.p: Typhoon Dale will mainly impact shipping during this period. It currently has winds of 75 mph and is located well east of Japan, moving east northeast at 65 mph. Dale will weaken to near 65 mph during the next 24 hours as it transitions into an extratropical weather system and moves rapidly out to sea.

Tropical Storm Ernie is moving west southwestward across the eastern South China Sea, and has top winds near 40 mph. It is a moderate threat to shipping, but this threat will decrease as the storm weakens over the next 24 hours. Some reintensifying is possible by 48 hours as Ernie remains on its forecast track.
There are no further statements at this time.
